summary.text: David P. Hinkins is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 26, a district covering Carbon, Emery, Garfield, Grand, Kane, San Juan, Utah, Wasatch and Wayne counties, and has served since January 2009. His official legislative profile lists his profession as electrician.

paragraphs.text: Hinkins graduated from Emery County High School and holds an associate degree from Utah Technical College at Provo.
He sits on the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment Committee.
